title: Counit normalization of exact pullback and its strict completed construction
statement:
Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Fix a Noetherian adic datum $(A,I)$, $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\ge1$, and $B_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$ for $T=X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Assume the projection-defined coefficient map $c_g:g^{-1}B_X\to B_Y$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] is an isomorphism. Use module sheaves, their unbounded derived categories and strict inverse sequences [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-inverse-system].

Write $G(M)=g^{-1}M\otimes_{g^{-1}B_X,c_g}B_Y$ for the recorded ordinary module pullback, and $F(M)$ for $g^{-1}M$ with scalars transported along $c_g^{-1}$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $m:G\xrightarrow{\sim}F$ be the module isomorphism sending $x\otimes b$ to $b\cdot x$. Assume $F$ is additive and exact. Denote its termwise derived descent by $F_D$, with localization comparison $\xi_P:F_D(Q_XP)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_Y(FP)$ [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. Let $L$ be the specified K-flat left-derived pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], with its universal counit $\epsilon_P:L(Q_XP)\to Q_Y(GP)$, where $Q_T$ denotes localization of cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-kflat-complex].

There is a unique natural isomorphism $e:L\xrightarrow{\sim}F_D$ satisfying
$$\xi_P e_{Q_XP}=Q_Y(m_P)\epsilon_P$$
for every complex $P$. The corresponding universal-counit-normalized isomorphism on derived strict towers identifies the specified left-derived levelwise pullback with $F_D^{\mathrm{Tow}}$. It agrees with $e$ under every tower evaluation and with $\Delta e$ on constant towers, using the exact-localization comparisons, where $\Delta$ denotes constant towers.

For $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))$, let $K_\bullet$ be its strict derived quotient tower. Applying total right derived limit to this tower isomorphism gives an isomorphism $d_K$ from the actual ambient strict completed pullback to $L_YF_D^{\mathrm{Tow}}K_\bullet$, where $L_Y=R\lim$. Let $\alpha_K$ be the actual comparison defined by the strict quotient augmentation in [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and let $\alpha^F_K:F_DK\to L_YF_D^{\mathrm{Tow}}K_\bullet$ be the same augmented construction with exact termwise $F$. Then
$$d_K\alpha_K=\alpha^F_K e_K.$$
The isomorphism $d_K$ commutes with each derived-limit evaluation through the preceding tower comparison. These assertions hold for every unbounded $K$, using the ambient augmented construction even when $K$ is not intrinsically complete.

proof.text: Apply the normalized ordinary/tower comparison to $R=B_X$, $S=B_Y$, $(f,c)=(g,c_g)$ and the specified $m:G\cong F$. It gives the unique $e$ and $E$ with exactly the required universal-counit equations, and the evaluation comparisons $v_n$, including every transition. Apply the quotient-augmentation square to these $e,E$. It gives $E_{\Delta K}b_K=c_K\Delta_Y(e_K)$ and identifies the actual and exact strict augmentations as $\beta_K=\widetilde L(a_K)b_K$ and $\beta^F_K=F_D^{\mathrm{Tow}}(a_K)c_K$, with $E_{K_\bullet}\beta_K=\beta^F_K\Delta_Y(e_K)$. Both lemmas use the specified universal derived pairs and actual quotient transitions; their hypotheses hold by the completed-pullback construction and the assumed exactness of $F$.

proof.text:
Let $L_Y=R\lim$ be the total right derived inverse-limit functor and put $d_K=L_Y(E_{K_\bullet})$. It is an isomorphism, since a functor sends an inverse pair to an inverse pair. Use the normalized adjunction $\Delta_Y\dashv L_Y$ with unit $u_C:C\to L_Y\Delta_YC$. The ambient construction in the completed-pullback definition is $\alpha_K=L_Y(\beta_K)u_{LK}$; the exact augmented construction is $\alpha^F_K=L_Y(\beta^F_K)u_{F_DK}$. These are exactly the chain-level compatible-map constructions: for a tower K-injective resolution of $\Delta_YC$, the adjunction unit is the map into its termwise limit induced by the compatible resolution maps. Apply $L_Y$ to Step 1 and use the unit's naturality $L_Y(\Delta_Ye_K)u_{LK}=u_{F_DK}e_K$. This yields
$$d_K\alpha_K=L_Y(E_{K_\bullet}\beta_K)u_{LK}=L_Y(\beta^F_K)L_Y(\Delta_Ye_K)u_{LK}=\alpha^F_Ke_K.$$
Both sides of this equality are the specified augmented maps.

proof.text:
For the natural derived-limit projections $\pi_{n,M}:L_YM\to\operatorname{ev}_nM$, apply the naturality asserted in the normalized tower-counit theorem to $E_{K_\bullet}$. It gives
$$\pi_{n,F_D^{\mathrm{Tow}}K_\bullet}d_K=\operatorname{ev}_n(E_{K_\bullet})\pi_{n,\widetilde L K_\bullet}.$$
Step 1 identifies the evaluated map with the prescribed ordinary comparison $e$ and $v_n$. This is the claimed derived-limit evaluation compatibility. All replacements and functors used above exist on unbounded complexes. The quotient augmentation, $\beta_K$, and $L_Y\beta_K\,u$ make sense for every $K$; completeness is needed only to restrict the completed-pullback functor to its intrinsic complete subcategory, not for any of these constructions or equalities. In particular the argument never identifies an arbitrary map of triangulated cones with the augmentation.
